purpose: Prospective independent-source one-year validation surface for Pineland. The source is a coalition military reporting archive, so the recorded-event prediction is primary and latent violence is diagnostic.

target_surface.source_silence_semantics: 0 means no qualifying report in this source for the province-week; it is not asserted to be latent peace.

mapping_frozen_before_rows.combat_regex: (?i)\b(ied|improvised explosive|direct fire|indirect fire|small arms|rocket|mortar|ambush|attack|engagement|firefight|complex attack|rpg|grenade|artillery|air strike|airstrike|close air support|cas)\b
mapping_frozen_before_rows.violent_evidence_rule: A row is violent if any Friendly/HostNation/Enemy killed-or-wounded field is positive OR combat_regex matches EventType, Category, Title, or Summary.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.hostile_insurgent_evidence_rule: A row is hostile-insurgent if enemy_affiliation_regex matches Affiliation OR enemy_display_regex matches DisplayColor OR any EnemyKilled/EnemyWounded/EnemyDetained field is positive OR taliban_regex matches Title or Summary.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.positive_event_rule: violent_evidence AND hostile_insurgent_evidence. This is a reported hostile-insurgent military-incident construct, not a claim that every row is uniquely Taliban-attributed.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.positive_cell_rule: At least one qualifying event in a province-week. Multiple qualifying reports collapse to one active incidence cell.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.negative_cell_rule: No qualifying report in the source for that province-week is coded 0 for predictive scoring only; source silence is not latent absence.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.spatial_rule: Latitude/Longitude point-in-polygon assignment to the existing frozen Afghanistan 34-province analysis geometry. Unmapped or boundary-ambiguous coordinates are rejected, never nearest-neighbor imputed.
mapping_frozen_before_rows.calendar_rule: Absolute week_index=floor((event_date-2004-01-01).days/7). The sealed scorer excludes partial week cells crossing the 2007 calendar boundaries.

allowed_claims: prospective predictive score of frozen Pineland recorded-event probabilities against an independently acquired coalition-reporting source
comparison with training-only empirical-rate competitors on the same source
forbidden_claims: War Diary source silence is true peace
War Diary reports are ground truth
a pass proves absence of all overfitting
War Diary outcomes may tune Pineland mechanisms, initialization, recording parameters, mapping, or scoring
